findings.detail: blockhash and bitsToHexhash throw UnsupportedOperationException. Default CLI calls blockhash; quick path eventually calls unimplemented bitsToHexhash. No successful public hash path established.
Even-path inner loops assign value = totalValue..., leaving only final pixel in each block before thresholding; not a sum.
Threshold halfBlockValue scales by full pixelsPerBlock despite overwritten single-pixel block value.
Alpha zero treated as white; every nonzero alpha ignores opacity. Signed getAlpha affects numeric interpretation but zero check still works.
Integer division excludes right/bottom remainders in quick path. Dimensions smaller than bits produce zero block widths/heights; no admission guard.
Even median uses float and ties-to-even integer rounding. Empty input indexes negative position; no admission guard.
getRed/getBlue names reverse BufferedImage ARGB red/blue positions; sum RGB unaffected, individual public getters misleading.
Resize/interpolation/debug behavior unfinished; parsed flag values consume following arguments. ImageIO.read null is not checked.
Five JUnit methods exercise median odd/even and RGB/RGBA totals only. Neither hashing public path nor CLI is exercised.
